title: Moishe Lettvin - What I Learned Doing 250 Interviews at Google
summary: Moishe Lettvin, a former Google engineer, shares lessons from 250 interviews and his time on the hiring committee. He tells how the committee given anonymized packets, including its own, would hire almost none of them.
why: Linked often in hiring-process threads for the anecdote about Google's committee refusing to hire itself, as evidence interviews are noisy.

quote.text: The one I found very enlightening is from Moishe Lettvin given at Etsy
